messages.subject: tutorial about Bayesian methods for psycholing was published
parts:
Hi, I just wanted to update the reference in the website (you have the arxiv citation there) of our tutorial that uses rstanarm. This is the new one:


@article {LNC3:LNC312207,
author = {Nicenboim, Bruno and Vasishth, Shravan},
title = {Statistical methods for linguistic research: {Foundational} Ideas -- {Part} II},
journal = {Language and Linguistics Compass},
volume = {10},
number = {11},
issn = {1749-818X},
url = {http://dx.doi.org/10.1111/lnc3.12207},
doi = {10.1111/lnc3.12207},
pages = {591--613},
year = {2016},
note = {LNCO-0657.R1},
}


I guess it could also go under tutorial, but it's up to you of course...

Thanks!

Bruno
